The way you position your hands in a Hardstyle Pushup can make a significant difference when progressing toward the One-Arm Pushup. It's not just about pressing yourself off the floor. It's about creating tension, building stability, and learning to generate force through a strong, connected body.
In this video, Karen Smith, StrongFirst Certified Master Instructor, demonstrates how to position your hand in the Hardstyle Pushup to prepare for the demands of the One-Arm Pushup.
A small technical adjustment can change how you generate tension and control your body throughout the movement.
